notes: No MSC 1 test file exercises a checksum-verified download — downloadLatestForPlugin, downloadLatestPaperTemplate, and downloadOrUpdateXboxBroadcastJar all repeat the same temp-then-move shape (streams to a temp file, moveItem's it over the final name once the download succeeds) but none of them checksum-verify what they downloaded. Characterized from msc2-engineering.md §7's requirement instead, using ResourcePackManager.sha1Hex's own hex-SHA1 shape as the checksum format precedent (the nearest thing MSC 1 has to a download checksum), since it's the same primitive family. 'd1434be5db668fbf3bfcc1887e9d9354e29428ef' is the real SHA1 of the literal bytes 'plugin-jar-contents-v1' (independently computed via Python's hashlib, not invented).
